ResourceInUseError.title: Resource already in use
ResourceInUseError.description: The resource is currently in use by another user and cannot be started by you until it is released.

ResourceUnhealthyException.title: Resource unhealthy
ResourceUnhealthyException.description: The resource is currently reporting an unhealthy state and cannot be used until it recovers.

INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.title: Insufficient balance
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: The balance is not sufficient for this action.

INVALID_CSV.title: Invalid CSV file
INVALID_CSV.description: The CSV file could not be processed. Check its format and try again.

Invalid API key.title: Invalid API key
Invalid API key.description: The API key is invalid. Please try again.

malformed pairing code.title: Invalid pairing code
malformed pairing code.description: The pairing code is invalid. Please try again.

no pairing for code.title: Invalid pairing code
no pairing for code.description: The pairing code is invalid. Please try again.

REFUND_AMOUNT_HIGHER_THAN_TRANSACTION_AM.title: Refund amount higher than transaction amount
REFUND_AMOUNT_HIGHER_THAN_TRANSACTION_AM.description: The refund amount is higher than the transaction amount

password must be longer than or equal to.title: Password too short
password must be longer than or equal to.description: Password must be at least 8 characters long.

Invalid username format.title: Invalid username
Invalid username format.description: Only letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, and dots are allowed.

Invalid username length.title: Invalid username
Invalid username length.description: Username must be between 3 and 32 characters.

ForbiddenSignupDomainException.title: Forbidden signup domain
ForbiddenSignupDomainException.description: The domain of the email address is not allowed.

UserEmailNotVerifiedException.description: Please verify your email before signing in. Check your inbox for the verification email or ask an administrator to resend it.

UnkownUserOrPasswordException.title: Unknown user or password
UnkownUserOrPasswordException.description: The user or password is invalid.

You cannot update your own permissions.description: You cannot change your own permissions. Ask another administrator to adjust them.

TwoFactorRequired.title: Two-factor code required
TwoFactorRequired.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.

TwoFactorInvalidCode.title: Invalid two-factor code
TwoFactorInvalidCode.description: The code is invalid or expired. Please try again.

TwoFactorSetupRequired.title: Two-factor setup required
TwoFactorSetupRequired.description: Your account must enable two-factor authentication before continuing.

TwoFactorAlreadyEnabled.title: Two-factor already enabled
TwoFactorAlreadyEnabled.description: Two-factor authentication is already enabled for your account.

TwoFactorNotInitialized.title: Two-factor not initialized
TwoFactorNotInitialized.description: Start the setup process before verifying your code.

TwoFactorNotEnabled.title: Two-factor not enabled
TwoFactorNotEnabled.description: Two-factor authentication is not enabled for your account.

DeleteAccountTokenInvalidException.description: The delete account confirmation link is invalid or has already been used.

DeleteAccountTokenExpiredException.description: The delete account confirmation link has expired. Please request a new one.

DeleteAccountUseSelfEndpoint.title: Cannot delete own account
DeleteAccountUseSelfEndpoint.description: Please delete your account from the account settings page.

UserHasActiveUsageSessions.title: User has active sessions
UserHasActiveUsageSessions.description: This user still has active usage sessions. End them before deleting the account.
